basic_info.description: Welcome to the Beautiful 2beds 1 bath in Nob Hill, a gem nestled in the heart of San Francisco, CA. This apartment offers two spacious bedrooms and a full bathroom, perfect for those who value comfort and convenience. The building is equipped with an elevator, ensuring easy access to your new home. For those who enjoy cycling around the city, the apartment provides bike storage facilities, keeping your bikes safe and secure. One of the standout features of this property is the Common Area Roof Deck. This shared space offers a unique opportunity to enjoy the outdoors, soak in the sun, and take in the breathtaking views of the city. Experience the best of San Francisco living in this well-appointed apartment.
